tasks.description: Requested additive synchronous lookup across MCPServer and ToolManager, a real multi-file dependency maintenance task; not an upstream bug report.
tasks.prompt: Add synchronous has_tool(name: str) -> bool APIs to MCPServer and its ToolManager. ToolManager checks exact case-sensitive registration membership without mutating state or executing the tool; MCPServer delegates to its manager. Missing/empty/differently-cased names return False, registered names True, removed names False. Preserve existing get/list/add/remove/call behavior. Add focused repository tests. Do not change other public APIs. Do not commit, submit/approve proposals or install dependencies. Finish with actual checks and unresolved issues.

tasks.description: Requested additive structured validation diagnostics with early-return and constructor compatibility; a bounded API/data-model maintenance task, not a reported defect.
tasks.prompt: Extend ToolNameValidationResult with invalid_characters: list[str] using an independent default list. Preserve existing two-positional-argument construction and all existing is_valid/warnings behavior. In the invalid-character branch of validate_tool_name, expose the already-computed unique invalid characters in first-seen order, including Unicode. Valid names and the existing empty/overlength early returns expose an empty list. Do not alter warning text, logging behavior, regex or existing validation order. Add focused repository tests. Do not commit, submit/approve proposals or install dependencies. Finish with actual checks and unresolved issues.

permissions: Same native tool permission policy in both conditions; all writes/bash reviewed once by operator. Graph condition adds only ChronosGraph MCP and managed context bridge.
cache_policy: Fresh isolated HOME/config/data/state/cache per attempt; source worktrees reset to pinned revision. Provider-side free-model cache cannot be reset or controlled; report cache-read/write categories separately.
comparison_policy: All attempts retained. Provider/installation/operator interruptions reported, no silent reruns. Success requires frozen external tests, selected existing regressions and no unintended source changes. Small 4-run pilot, not statistical proof. Wall time includes operator permission waits; report them separately when observable.
prior_exposure: The repository was previously indexed and used for different display-name/path-refactor tasks; these two task instances were not used to tune ChronosGraph. Source was inspected to define independent acceptance; agents receive no solution patches.
cost_policy: Free model; zero reported charge is not proof of paid-equivalent savings. Preserve completed-step token categories; provider retry usage remains unknown.
ingestion_policy: Fresh immutable graph snapshot before graph attempts; account for elapsed ingestion/refresh separately, do not include prior graph findings.

setup_amendment.retained_failed_setup: Default 100-path mandatory pack exceeded budget at trial-3 preparation; HTTP422 CONSTRAINT_OVERFLOW. No agent trial had started.
setup_amendment.limitations: Same requested task and tools; graph managed pack explicitly bounds scope to 12 paths and marks truncation. It is not comprehensive impact coverage. Out-of-scope proposals require expansion. No mandatory rule within selected scope removed.
